{"people":[{"name":"Priya","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Daniel","role":"VP of Engineering, signer","side":"customer"},{"name":"CFO (unnamed)","role":"CFO","side":"customer"},{"name":"Engineer (unnamed)","role":"Customer engineer who built the weekend prototype","side":"customer"},{"name":"Engineer (unnamed, Daniel's)","role":"Customer engineer at kickoff","side":"customer"}],
"competitors":["Braintree"],
"incumbent":"Not explicitly stated. The competitor's account-manager churn and the PayPal/Venmo/saved-card concerns suggest the incumbent was Braintree, but the transcript never says so.",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Expansion. They were launching Canada, then the UK, and sitters have to get paid locally.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger: international expansion requires local sitter payouts."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"a haunted house","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own vivid term for the legacy payments code."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Maintenance cost. Hedged ('more or less') and source not stated."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"a roadmap item, faster pay for sitters, that had been pushed three quarters in a row.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Blocked roadmap item is a concrete pain driver."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Daniel. He signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Engineering leader was the decider and signer."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CFO joined one call for ten minutes, asked one question","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Finance had minimal involvement."},
{"id":"E7","turn":4,"excerpt":"does this change when sitters get paid?","label":"quote","speaker":"CFO","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","language"],"note":"Finance cared only about sitter pay timing."},
{"id":"E8","turn":4,"excerpt":"this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Says finance would sign, yet rep says Daniel signed."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"Their account manager had changed three times in two years.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Customer complaint about the competitor's service continuity."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"I've stopped learning their names.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Customer's words on frustration with competitor account management."},
{"id":"E11","turn":6,"excerpt":"A lot of pet owners pay with PayPal and Venmo, and they were nervous about what happens to those buttons.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Key switching risk: the PayPal/Venmo checkout buttons."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"They had a call with Braintree in the middle of the evaluation.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Braintree was engaged mid-evaluation."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"It went from \"how fast can we build this\" to \"what do we lose.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Observed shift in customer questions after the Braintree call."},
{"id":"E14","turn":8,"excerpt":"Do we lose PayPal, do we lose Venmo, what happens to the saved cards.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Specific loss-aversion concerns raised by the customer."},
{"id":"E15","turn":8,"excerpt":"I assume Braintree told them they'd lose things. I don't know that. That's me guessing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor tactic is pure speculation."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the docs and the sandbox.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read of what resonated. E17 supports it."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"One of their engineers, on her own time, built a working sitter payment flow over a weekend and showed it at Monday standup.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Unprompted prototype is strong evidence that developer experience sells."},
{"id":"E18","turn":10,"excerpt":"I didn't even know until Daniel told me.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"The deciding event happened without rep involvement."},
{"id":"E19","turn":10,"excerpt":"And the marketplace piece. Onboarding sitters, the identity checks, paying out in local currency.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Rep's read of the reaction. Uses 'marketplace' and 'paying out', which the customer doesn't say."},
{"id":"E20","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the acceptance-rate slide. I did the whole thing, the average improvement customers see.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Acceptance-rate message fell flat."},
{"id":"E21","turn":10,"excerpt":"our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Explicit rejection of the auth-rate value prop for a low-ticket business."},
{"id":"E22","turn":12,"excerpt":"The weekend prototype. Before that it was a bake-off.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep identifies the prototype as the turning point."},
{"id":"E23","turn":12,"excerpt":"After that Daniel stopped saying \"if.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Observed change in the decider's language."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"Nothing, really. It was a clean one.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Claims no gaps; contradicted by E25 through E33."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"We kind of danced around it. We said they could keep offering PayPal and we'd work through the details in implementation.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","competitor"],"note":"No real answer on PayPal; deferred to implementation."},
{"id":"E26","turn":16,"excerpt":"I didn't have a crisp answer on Venmo in the room, and I still don't.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Unresolved Venmo gap persists after the deal closed."},
{"id":"E27","turn":16,"excerpt":"They decided it was a risk they'd take.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Customer accepted the risk, per rep's characterization."},
{"id":"E28","turn":18,"excerpt":"That one we handled.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Claim undercut by the unanswered reference request (E30, E31)."},
{"id":"E29","turn":18,"excerpt":"But it was a doc and a conversation.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Saved-card migration was supported only by a doc and talk, no proof."},
{"id":"E30","turn":18,"excerpt":"who's done this at our size without losing cards?","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer asked for a reference or proof point at their scale."},
{"id":"E31","turn":18,"excerpt":"I said I'd get back to him. I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Unfulfilled follow-up; a proof gap."},
{"id":"E32","turn":20,"excerpt":"Once, in the kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Saved-card concern resurfaced after signing."},
{"id":"E33","turn":20,"excerpt":"we'll find out.","label":"quote","speaker":"Customer engineer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Customer is still uncertain about card migration post-sale."},
{"id":"E34","turn":22,"excerpt":"Payments shouldn't be a team","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Repeated customer framing: payments as a staffing burden."},
{"id":"E35","turn":22,"excerpt":"We want to stop babysitting this.","label":"quote","speaker":"Customer (unattributed, likely Daniel)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer language for the maintenance pain."},
{"id":"E36","turn":22,"excerpt":"paid by Friday","label":"quote","speaker":"Customer (sitter-side promise)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Core customer promise to sitters."},
{"id":"E37","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody there says \"marketplace.\" They say \"the app.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our category term isn't theirs."},
{"id":"E38","turn":22,"excerpt":"And nobody says \"payouts.\" They say \"sitter pay.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our feature term isn't theirs."},
{"id":"E39","turn":24,"excerpt":"Only that I barely sold this. Their engineer did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Win attributed to a customer engineer's hands-on experience."}],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E24","E25","E26","E30","E31"],"what":"Rep says nothing was missing ('a clean one'), then admits dancing around PayPal, having no Venmo answer, and never providing a reference for saved-card migration."},
{"evidence":["E28","E30","E31","E33"],"what":"Rep says saved cards were 'handled', but the reference question went unanswered and the customer's engineer still says 'we'll find out' at kickoff."},
{"evidence":["E5","E8"],"what":"Rep says Daniel signed, while Daniel had said finance would sign what he brought them. Who formally signed is unclear."}],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did they ask for that we couldn't show?","turn":14,"what":"Answered 'Nothing, really', then contradicted under follow-up (PayPal/Venmo gap, missing saved-card reference)."},
{"question":"Earlier you said they were nervous about the PayPal and Venmo buttons. What did we show them on that?","turn":16,"what":"Rep admits the team 'danced around it' with the customer and deferred details to implementation."},
{"question":"And the saved cards?","turn":18,"what":"Claims it was handled; the reference request was never answered."}],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the app","ours":"marketplace","evidence":["E37","E19"]},
{"theirs":"sitter pay","ours":"payouts / paying out in local currency","evidence":["E38","E19"]},
{"theirs":"auth rates (not a concern at $38 average booking)","ours":"acceptance-rate","evidence":["E21","E20"]},
{"theirs":"paid by Friday","ours":"faster pay for sitters","evidence":["E36","E4"]}],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E5"],"what":"Won: Daniel signed."},
{"evidence":["E17","E22","E23","E39"],"what":"Win driven by an engineer's weekend prototype built in our sandbox; rep says she barely sold it."},
{"evidence":["E26","E27","E32","E33"],"what":"Open post-sale risks: Venmo and saved-card migration are unresolved, and the customer accepted the risk. The transcript doesn't say whether only part of the business moved."}]}

contradictions.what: Rep says nothing was missing ('a clean one'), then admits dancing around PayPal, having no Venmo answer, and never providing a reference for saved-card migration.
Rep says saved cards were 'handled', but the reference question went unanswered and the customer's engineer still says 'we'll find out' at kickoff.
Rep says Daniel signed, while Daniel had said finance would sign what he brought them. Who formally signed is unclear.

dodges.question: And the saved cards?

outcome_signals.what: Win driven by an engineer's weekend prototype built in our sandbox; rep says she barely sold it.
Open post-sale risks: Venmo and saved-card migration are unresolved, and the customer accepted the risk. The transcript doesn't say whether only part of the business moved.
